LanguageData.NMC_MothershipPointShop.label: Mothership shop
LanguageData.NMC_MothershipPointShop.description:
A supply trade terminal. Buy with P points or donate supplies within orbital beacon range for P rewards.
Restocks every 7 days with at most 60 random goods across the whole shop. All colonies share stock. Select a delivery colony and goods; confirmed purchases are dropped near its beacon. Requires a powered orbital trade beacon and a valid open-air drop site.
